newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair shares up despite lower H1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Finnair shares up despite lower H1 profit.

text.p: Shares in Finnish state-controlled airline Finnair rose in thin trade on Friday despite a slightly lower than expected first-half profit, brokers said.
At 1430/1230 GMT, Finnair traded at 32.90, up 0.90 markka or 2.88 percent.
Finnair's 233.5 million markka pre-tax profit for April-September was a touch below the 292 million markka median forecast. In the year-ago period Finnair's pre-tax profit was 463 million markka.
But, brokers said the longer term outlook for Finnair was a lot brighter.
"Finnair has already gone through severe belt-tightening, I think this should show eventually," one broker said.
"I think there will be buy recommendations for Finnair," another broker said.
